questions.question: How many strings does a standard guitar have?
questions.explanation: A standard guitar has 6 strings — E, A, D, G, B, E from thickest to thinnest! 🎸

questions.question: Which instrument has 88 keys?
questions.explanation: A standard piano has 88 keys — 52 white and 36 black! 🎹

questions.question: What are the 7 musical notes?
options: A B C D E F G
Do Re Mi Fa Sol La Si
questions.explanation: A-B-C-D-E-F-G and Do-Re-Mi-Fa-Sol-La-Si are two naming systems for the same 7 notes! 🎵

questions.question: Which famous composer was deaf?
questions.explanation: Beethoven composed his famous 9th Symphony when he was completely deaf — incredible! 🎼

questions.question: How many colours are in the spectrum used in painting?
questions.explanation: There are 3 primary colours in painting: Red, Yellow, Blue — mix these to make all others! 🎨

questions.question: What is the world's most played instrument?
questions.explanation: The human voice is technically an instrument — and everyone has one! 🎤

questions.question: What instrument does a 'drummer' play?
questions.explanation: A drum kit has bass drum, snare, cymbals and tom-toms — the heartbeat of a band! 🥁
